# Hello, I'm Lawal 👋🏾

[![AltSchool Engineering](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Engineering-6773E5?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/png;base64,&logoColor=white)](https://engineering.altschoolafrica.com/) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/-lawaloyinlola.com-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=Google-Chrome&logoColor=white)](https://lawaloyinlola.com) [![Résumé](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Résumé-2563EB?style=for-the-badge&logoColor=white)](https://resume.lawaloyinlola.com) [![Security](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Security_labs-15803D?style=for-the-badge&logoColor=white)](https://lawaloyinlola.com/security) [![LinkedIn](https://img.shields.io/badge/-LinkedIn-0A66C2?style=for-the-badge&logo=linkedin&logoColor=white)](https://linkedin.com/in/lawaloyinlola)

I'm a **software engineer who works in application security**. I build web products in React, Next.js and TypeScript, take them full stack when needed, and then test them the way an attacker would.

On Trakkam, a multi-tenant GPS fleet SaaS I architected, that meant taking dependency vulnerabilities from 104 to 0 and leaked secrets from 15 to 0 in CI, then reading the code by hand and fixing 11 more issues in one pass. I lead a small team at Tech'N Goodwill, build the frontend at SafulPay, and publish my own security labs.

### What I've shipped

- **Trakkam**: multi-tenant GPS fleet management, built end to end (Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, Socket.io, Mapbox) and self-hosted for about 8× less than a managed stack.
- **SafulPay website**: re-platformed to Next.js, with Lighthouse going from 68 to 100 in all four categories.
- **SafulPay agency banking dashboard**: onboarding and verification for a network of 1,300+ agents.
- **[appsec-protocols](https://github.com/lawalOyinlola/appsec-protocols)**: the security baseline I apply to every project.
